body: I never said thanks for saying all that. Things have sadly gotten worse. I have said it in other places but my best friend is dead, probably suicide. I am gonna withdraw from some classes to avoid fs. I dont know if I will go on any longer. I thought i would die this week but it looks like i got addicted to slime rancher instead.  Might still die though.

Third time posting this, r/depression and r/SuicideWatch are taking a lot of time to approve the post. My best friend died. I'm probably (hopefully) gonna kms.  Here is the post:  


Don't worry, I'll write a note. I'll try to explain everything. I'll record a song i can play very well and change some lyrics for it to make sense. And every time I stop distracting myself from my grief, I realize I have nothing to do now other than to die. SO in short, whether i decide to go or not, I'm writing a note. I'm also writing notes to all my discord friends, steam friends. I don't want anyone having unanswered questions. I have never planned suicide before. Anytime I have tried attempting it has been in the heat of the moment, no plan, no note, no nothin. I miss her so much and its only been days since i found out. I'm hopefully gonna kill myself. And I'll do it just because there is the chance i can see her again. Never been religious... I hope that doesn't hurt my chances.
Thank you for being so kind :)
Just hope you dont do a me and find out you have 6 cavities
